HyperIso_candidate.conclusion: Public custom registration replaces named group and requires explicit RG; no demonstrated zero-native-BSM built-in B factory. Existing SM semantics and basis concern preserved.

blockers: CW_calculator zeros C0w at entry, then caps C7H_1/C8H_1 against these still-zero C0w[7,8] before assigning the LO coefficients. Every tested native NLO NP dipole is erased; C4 survives. Native rate is not a valid NLO one-state oracle.
Public rate API rematches high-scale native coefficients for power and electromagnetic terms; arbitrary low-scale injection alone is incomplete.

Uncapped G7H/G8H expressions contain -4 C4/9 and -C4/6 relative to ordinary BMU, while C_calculator_base1 applies effective conversion again. A separately verified source-specific basis oracle is required in addition to resolving clipping.
Native NNLO matching cannot be compared as an oracle to NLO-only injected matching. Equal-order diagnostics below remain diagnostics, not a complete matched NNLO prediction.

conventions.diagnostic_accuracy: LO+NLO matching; all C^(2) matching set to zero for both paths; NNLO RG/rate kernels retained. Not complete NNLO and not a strict NLO truncation.
conventions.diagnostic_primed: Same native SM primed dipoles used for both paths; native THDM Cprime returns SM only
conventions.internal_corrections: bsgamma_Ecut recomputes C0w from native param in N_E0 and P_em
conventions.native_accuracy: Nominal legacy NNLO implementation, historical charm interpolation and rate fallback. Actual native NP NLO dipoles are clipped to zero by pre-assignment C0w cap. Not a validated NNLO result.
conventions.scheme: NDR standard Q1-Q8, MSbar matching top; effective dipoles at low scale
conventions.uncertainty: No calibrated Zee uncertainty/covariance or likelihood; native nuisance file retains 4% bsgamma_rand; not assigned here
